csv.title: Import questions from a CSV file
csv.intro: Write questions in a spreadsheet, save it as CSV, and bring it here. You'll see a preview before anything is added.
csv.formatTitle: What the file should look like
csv.formatIntro: The first row names the columns. Each following row is one question. Commas, semicolons or tabs all work.

col.question: Required. The question text (can be empty if the question is an image).
col.cf: Optional. More choices, up to six in all. Don't leave gaps.
col.correct: Required. The right choice: a letter (A–F), a number (1–6) or the choice's exact text. Only one.
col.explanation: Optional. Why the answer is right.
col.topic: Optional. The name of a topic in this course. A name that isn't found is kept as the area label.
col.unit: Optional. The unit's name, when two topics share a name.
col.area: Optional. A short label to group results by (also: skill, concept, tag).
col.images: Optional. A picture's file name — you upload the files in the next step.

sample.q1why: Dissolved calcium and magnesium salts cause hardness.
sample.q2: Which step does the picture show?
